use core.files as files
use core.process as process

fn escape_json(s: String) String -> {
    result := ""
    loop ch in s.chars() {
        if ch == '"' -> result += "\\\""
        else if ch == '\\' -> result += "\\\\"
        else if ch == '\n' -> result += "\\n"
        else if ch == '\t' -> result += "\\t"
        else -> result += "{ch}"
    }
    return result
}

fn run() {
    path :: process.argv().get(1) ?? panic("missing path")
    text :: files.read(path) ?? panic("read failed")

    name := ""
    count := 0
    note := ""

    loop line in text.lines() {
        if line.trim().is_empty() -> next
        parts := [String]{}
        loop p in line.split("\t") -> parts.push(p)
        if parts.len() < 2 -> next
        key :: parts[0].trim()
        value :: parts[1].trim()
        if key == "name" -> name = value
        else if key == "count" -> count = value.to_int() ?? panic("bad count")
        else if key == "note" -> note = value
    }

    out := ""
    out += "{{"
    out += "\"count\":{count},"
    out += "\"name\":\"{escape_json(name)}\","
    out += "\"note\":\"{escape_json(note)}\""
    out += "}}"
    print(out)
}
